tweet.text:
subagents work ok.  Though my impression is that with a group of subagents leave all the writing to one, while the others are readers.  I don't know if that's true for all agent systems.

But the problem I'm working on is a bit different.  Give a squad of agents N stories, and have them assemble that into a cogent whole by working in parallel.   Many writers.  Lots of merges.  Lots of stepping all over each other.
